test.title: Coordination Compounds - Test 4
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:
Choose the correct Statements from the following:
(A) Ethane-1, 2-diamine is a chelating ligand.
(B) Metallic aluminium is produced by electrolysis of aluminium oxide in presence of cryolite.
(C) Cyanide ion is used as ligand for leaching of silver.
(D) Phosphine act as a ligand in Wilkinson catalyst.
(E) The stability constants of Ca2+ and Mg2+ are similar with EDTA complexes.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

The correct order of the calculated spin-only magnetic moments of complexes A to D is:
A NiCO4
B NiH2O6Cl2
C Na2NiCN4
D PdCl2PPh32

B. TiH2O63+ II. -2.0
C. FeCN63- III. -1.2
D. NiF64- IV. -0.4

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

Both Statement <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></math> and Statement <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>II</mi></math> are true.
